description: Source code for a Linux kernel module implementing a Real Time Clock (RTC) driver for WL-HDD, including I2C communication, platform detection, and RTC time read/write operations.

methods.name: rtc_open
methods.description: Opens the RTC device, initializes I2C, and locks the device.

methods.name: rtc_release
methods.description: Releases the RTC device and unlocks it.

methods.name: rtc_read
methods.description: Reads the current RTC time and outputs it in a formatted string.

methods.name: rtc_write
methods.description: Sets the RTC time based on a formatted input string.

methods.name: rtc_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for reading and setting RTC time.

methods.name: get_rtc_time
methods.description: Reads time from the RTC hardware via I2C.

methods.name: set_rtc_time
methods.description: Writes time to the RTC hardware via I2C.

methods.name: rtc_init
methods.description: Initializes the RTC driver, detects platform, and switches RTC to 24h mode.

methods.name: rtc_exit
methods.description: Cleans up the driver on module removal.
